annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard is a voluntary practice for recording environmental conditions in A-UGV test methods and names no bound parties, only noting that the user is responsible for establishing safety practices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to establish appropriate safety, health, and environmental practices
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Standard Practice for Recording Environmental Effects for Utilization with A-UGV Test Methods
